item.title: Refactor orders status String into OrderStatus enum
item.brief:
The `orders` crate stores an order's status as a `String` and compares string literals all over the code. Refactor it to a proper type.

Requirements:
- Add `src/status.rs` with `pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }` deriving at least `Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash`.
- `OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str` returns the lowercase names ("pending", "paid", "shipped", "cancelled"); `Display` prints the same.
- `FromStr` for `OrderStatus` with `type Err = ParseStatusError`, a public error type that implements `std::error::Error` and whose message names the rejected input.
- `OrderStatus::can_transition_to(self, next: OrderStatus) -> bool` encodes the lifecycle: pending -> paid, pending -> cancelled, paid -> shipped, paid -> cancelled; nothing else.
- `Order::status` becomes an `OrderStatus`; re-export `OrderStatus` and `ParseStatusError` from the crate root; use the enum everywhere, so the status string literals appear only in `src/status.rs`.

Observable behaviour (errors, report output and ordering, parsing) must stay exactly the same, and `cargo test` must pass. Commit the work on the local branch (ship local; no push).

Acceptance criteria: `cargo test` passes; no status string literals outside `src/status.rs`; the public items above exist with the stated signatures; report output and ordering unchanged from the baseline.

reasons: sizer: elevated -> high; capped at medium; consider a stronger tier; unchanged

stages.summary:
Baseline and characterization for "Refactor orders status String into OrderStatus enum" (attempt 1, no feedback to address).

Commits (branch archon/zvvetgk3-refactor-orders-status-string-into-order, no push):
- Original baseline: 3db8d3c "bench fixture" (tree 6e35d20143ea2a04a1a2774dbb91a210c78ccdcf).
- Characterization: 80ced61 "test: characterize order status transitions, reports and CSV parsing" (tree b7188cd34286261fa49c7557edab9ec0b4a4adaa). Adds only tests/characterization.rs (16 tests). No production code changed. Worktree clean.

Repo guidance: no README, Makefile, CI or lint config. The only declared checks are cargo test/build; I also ran clippy and fmt as informational checks. All commands run with CARGO_TARGET_DIR set to the item cache.
Before tests (3db8d3c): cargo test exit 0 (3 tests); cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings exit 0; cargo build exit 0; cargo fmt --check exit 1 (pre-existing drift in src/billing.rs, src/order.rs, src/report.rs, src/shipping.rs, tests/orders.rs; not reformatted).
After tests (80ced61): cargo test exit 0 (16 new + 3 original pass); clippy exit 0; build exit 0; fmt --check exit 1 with the same five pre-existing files only (new file is rustfmt-clean).

Public surface to keep (current behaviour):
- Root: pub mod billing/order/report/shipping; pub use order::Order.
- Order { pub id: u32, pub customer: String, pub total_cents: u64, pub status: String }, derives Debug, Clone, PartialEq. Order::new(id, &str, u64) starts "pending". is_open() is true for pending/paid. cancel() -> Result<(), String>, allowed from pending/paid, else "order {id} cannot be cancelled: it is {status}".
- billing::pay(&mut Order) -> Result<(), String>, pending->paid only, else "order {id} cannot be paid: it is {status}". billing::outstanding_cents(&[Order]) -> u64, sums pending only.
- shipping::ship(&mut Order) -> Result<(), String>, paid->shipped only, else "order {id} cannot be shipped: it is {status}". shipping::ready_to_ship(&[Order]) -> Vec<u32>, paid ids in input order.
- report::status_counts(&[Order]) -> Vec<(String, usize)>: only present statuses, sorted by the string (BTreeMap<String>), so output is cancelled, paid, pending, shipped.
- report::to_line(&Order) -> "id,customer,total_cents,status". report::from_line(&str) -> Result<Order, String>: trims the whole line, requires 4 fields ("expected 4 fields, got N"), then id ("bad id {:?}: {e}"), then total ("bad total {:?}: {e}"), then status ("unknown status {:?}", case-sensitive, empty rejected).
- The transition set the brief specifies is exactly what the existing operations allow (pending->paid, paid->shipped, pending/paid->cancelled).
- Brief-allowed change: Order::status type becomes OrderStatus, plus the new items and root re-exports. Everything else above must stay byte-identical.

Characterization coverage (tests/characterization.rs, type-agnostic via status.to_string()): transition refusals and exact messages for every state; is_open; outstanding_cents and ready_to_ship including empty and mixed input; status_counts all-four ordering, omitted absent statuses and duplicate sums; to_line for each status; from_line round-trip, whitespace trim, empty customer, field-count errors, id/total/status check precedence, overflow message, case-sensitive unknown status; and the String error types.

Decisions and gaps for the refactorer and verifier:
1. Pitfall: status_counts order is lexicographic by name. A derived Ord on the enum (declaration order Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled) would change it. Pinned by status_counts_lists_all_four_statuses_sorted_by_name.
2. Acceptance criterion "no status literals outside src/status.rs" conflicts with tests. Literals occur in src/ (billing 3, order 4, report 1 line with all four in KNOWN, shipping 3) and in tests/orders.rs (4 lines) and my tests (~44 lines, the pinned expected strings). My reading: the criterion covers src/; test expectations may keep literals as pinned output. The verifier should confirm. No existing assertion may be weakened to satisfy it.
3. Open: status_counts returns Vec<(String, usize)>, a public signature the brief does not explicitly allow changing. "Use the enum everywhere" could allow Vec<(OrderStatus, usize)>, but then the sort must still be alphabetical by name, not derived Ord.
4. Open: Order derives Debug, so {:?} output today shows status: "pending". With an enum and derived Debug it becomes status: Pending. Not pinned, because the brief's derive requirement implies the change. The verifier should decide whether this counts as an observable change.
5. Known gaps: to_line does not escape commas (a customer containing a comma produces an unparseable line); customer with whitespace is not trimmed in from_line; direct mutation of the public status field is not tested; outstanding_cents u64 overflow is untested.

Assumptions: cargo fmt drift is pre-existing and not a gate; the git user is mengsig, and no Claude attribution is added to commits, per the CLAUDE.md rule. No services were started, so nothing needs stopping. Operator checkout untouched.

open_decisions: status_counts sort is lexicographic not derived Ord

pr.body: Approach: add src/status.rs with OrderStatus (Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash; as_str, Display via f.pad, FromStr, can_transition_to) and ParseStatusError (Display 'unknown status {input:?}', impl Error). Order::status becomes OrderStatus. billing::pay, shipping::ship and Order::cancel check can_transition_to, keeping the same error messages. report::status_counts keys a BTreeMap by as_str() so output stays sorted by name (no derived Ord, which would sort by declaration order). report::from_line keeps its check order (field count, id, total, status) and maps ParseStatusError to the same 'unknown status' message. Root re-exports OrderStatus and ParseStatusError. Module status is private. Key files: src/status.rs, src/order.rs, src/billing.rs, src/shipping.rs, src/report.rs, src/lib.rs. Public signatures unchanged except Order::status type (brief-authorized); status_counts still returns Vec<(String, usize)>. Checks: cargo test passes (4 unit, 16 characterization, 3 original); clippy and build exit 0; fmt drift only in pre-existing and touched lines. Assumptions/limits: derived Debug of Order now prints status: Pending instead of status: "pending" (consequence of the enum, not pinned by a test); direct assignment of a string to the public status field no longer compiles; to_line does not escape commas (pre-existing, untouched).
pr.summary: made order status a typed OrderStatus enum. now: lifecycle rules in can_transition_to, parsing via FromStr, status literals only in src/status.rs. before: String status compared by literal in 4 modules, now: enum everywhere. report output, ordering, errors unchanged; 23 tests pass.
pr.title: refactor: use OrderStatus enum for order status

risk.why: Breaking public API change: Order::status is now a different type (brief-authorized), so external callers comparing against string literals will not compile. Derived Debug output of Order changes. Touches the lifecycle and CSV parsing in 5 files. Behaviour is pinned by 19 pre-existing and characterization tests, all passing; no test was weakened. Per the rubric, a breaking API change and cross-cutting refactor go to high.
